evidence.quote: No tuition fees: as a state university, HTW Berlin does not charge tuition fees.
HTW Berlin does not charge tuition fees.
You should apply via uni-assist if you have a foreign higher education entrance qualification and are not a national of an EU or EEA country.
You should apply via uni-assist if you have a foreign higher education entrance qualification and are not a national of an EU or EEA country.

notes: Tuition: no tuition fee is charged (amountMinor 0) for this state-university programme, as stated; only a semester fee applies (a semester fee of 375.30 EUR is listed as the total for full-time on-campus degree programmes, winter semester 2026/27), evidence: https://www.htw-berlin.de/en/studies/study-organisation/semester-fee "Semester fee for full-time on-campus degree programmes and Studienkolleg (preparatory college) Administration fee 50.00 €" (table total 375.30 €). Intakes: application page (https://cyber-security-business.htw-berlin.de/application) gives the non-EU application period in day/month only ('01.05. - 30.06.') with no year; recorded as recurringDeadline 30 June, opening 1 May not recorded as a fact because year is absent. Application channel: applying via uni-assist is what the programme page states for foreign higher education entrance qualification holders from outside the EU/EEA; the text uses 'should', but no separate VPD route is named anywhere in the supplied pages, and the DAAD page says 'Submit application via Please check this website.'
